newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Walker sells funds management stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Walker sells funds management stake.

text.p: Property group Walker Corp Ltd said on Thursday that it has sold its 50 percent interest in the fund management entities of Industrial Property Trust of Australia to Macquarie Bank Ltd.

In a joint statement, Macquarie Bank said that as a result, the fund management company of Industrial Property Trust, Industrial Property Management Ltd, would become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Macquarie Bank.
Industrial Property Trust had shareholder funds of A$76 million and A$116 million in gross assets, comprising eight industrial properties in New South Wales and Queensland.
Walker Corp managing director Lang Walker said Walker Corp had decided to sell its interest in the entities in order to focus on its property development activities.

"The sale of the interest will remove any potential conflict for Walkers in the future sales of its properties and/or developments to IPTA and to other property investors," Walker said in a statement.
